As of 2007, its southern terminus is located at an intersection with SR 102A in Tremont on the southern part of the island. Its northern terminus is at intersection with SR 3 in Bar Harbor, a terminus it shares with SR 198.. SR 102 begins in the south at the intersection of Harbor Drive and Tremont Road in Tremont. According to the 2010 census, the island has a year-round population of 10,615. In 2017, an estimated 3.5 million tourists visited Acadia National Park on MDI.[7] The island is home to numerous well-known summer colonies such as Northeast Harbor and Bar Harbor..
